newsitem.title: USA: Freddie Mac to buy $1.075 bln MRBs in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Freddie Mac to buy $1.075 bln MRBs in 1996.

text.p: The Federal Home Loan Mortgage Corp, or Freddie Mac, said Monday it will buy a record $1.075 billion in mortgage revenue bonds from housing finance agencies this year.
Freddie Mac said it has bought $875 million so far this year, and expects to purchase another $200 million by year end. In 1995, Freddie Mac said it bought $200 million MRBs.
Freddie Mac also said it will commit more than $145 million to low-income housing tax credit equity funds this year.
